activation: No existing route imports, webhook registration, account-default version changes, migration, or real payment operations in this slice.

transport.query_authority: One fixed server-owned query. Additional caller options ignored; identifiers cannot supply paths or queries.
transport.response: Canonical response is not normalized. Missing expansion is a hard adapter rejection, never assumed zero.
transport.webhook: Exact raw-body signature verification and configured account/mode/API version checks precede canonical invoice retrieval. Event inline settlement data is never authoritative.
transport.limits: Existing per-request timeout and complete bounded line pagination preserved. A whole-operation deadline remains a separate integration gate.

invoice_schema.parent: parent.type must be subscription_details; parent.subscription_details.subscription is documented string/expandable subscription ID. A simultaneous nonnull quote_details is rejected.
invoice_schema.settlement: status=paid; amount_paid_off_stripe must be numeric zero; amount_remaining=0; status_transitions.paid_at must be a positive safe integer. No legacy paid or paid_out_of_band fallback.
invoice_schema.amount_authority: USD invoice amount_paid, amount_due, total and one line amount must each equal the server-bound catalog monthly amount. Canonical price product/amount/monthly recurring interval also validated.
invoice_schema.purpose: Only subscription_create and subscription_cycle. Update/proration/trial/free/zero-dollar invoices do not grant under this policy.
invoice_schema.legacy_rejection: Presence, even null, of old top-level subscription, subscription_details, subscription_proration_date, quote, paid, paid_out_of_band, payment_intent or charge rejects a legacy/mixed envelope.

line_schema.identity: object=line_item, exact configured livemode, complete list with exactly one line.
line_schema.parent: parent.type=subscription_item_details; nested subscription string must equal invoice parent subscription; subscription_item must be a canonical si_ ID; proration must be false. Nonnull invoice_item_details rejects ambiguity.
line_schema.pricing: pricing.type=price_details; price_details object required; price is documented expandable string ID, product is a string ID. Both match immutable configured price/product and retrieved canonical Price. pricing.unit_amount_decimal must equal the catalog integer amount in the exact-decimal subset below.
line_schema.pricing_documentation: Nested Markdown pricing fetch was unavailable; exact type definitions were read from the public HTML page's embedded Markdoc schema, not inferred from field names. Schema extracted to research/embedded_exact_fields.json in the review evidence.
line_schema.quantity: Both quantity===1 and a string quantity_decimal representing exactly one are required. quantity is documented as truncated integer precision; quantity_decimal is documented nullable decimal string, max 12 places. Missing/null decimal is deliberately unsupported, not repaired from integer quantity.
line_schema.exact_decimal_subset: Accepted one-unit strings: 1 or 1 followed by a decimal point and 1-12 zeros. Unit amount uses the exact catalog integer with optional 1-12 decimal zeros. Leading zeros, plus signs, exponent notation, whitespace, nonzero fractions, nonstrings and >12 decimal places reject. This is a conservative supported subset, not a claim that Stripe accepts no other decimal spellings.
line_schema.legacy_rejection: Presence of top-level type, subscription, subscription_item, invoice_item, proration, proration_details, price or plan rejects legacy/mixed schema.

supported_settlement_subset_and_exclusio.supported: Full catalog-price USD monthly subscription, one unit and non-prorated line, settled on Stripe, with no recorded adjustments.
supported_settlement_subset_and_exclusio.presence: These nullable arrays must exist and be null or []; undefined/missing/malformed values are unknown and rejected. The mandatory zero fields must be numeric zero, not missing/null/string.
deliberately_excluded_legitimate_cases: Any full or partial out-of-band payment.
Positive or negative customer balance at invoice start/end, including purchased customer credit used for payment or unrelated carried balances.
Tax and discount records, including zero-valued records, inclusive taxes and compensating tax/discount changes whose net amount equals catalog price.
Any pre/post-payment credit note or pretax credit record.
Overpayments, shipping additions, fractional/multiple quantities, multiple lines, prorations and manual/update invoices.
Incomplete or unavailable canonical pagination; unavailable settlement expansion.
supported_settlement_subset_and_exclusio.refund_limit: This is fulfillment validation, not a refund/chargeback policy or reversal handler. It does not introduce payment reversal or revoke historical allowances. Those lifecycle policies remain separate.

historical_period_authority.rule: Use the paid invoice's canonical line.period plus the immutable historical server term. Current subscription status/price/item period cannot overwrite historical authority.
historical_period_authority.documented_change: Subscription top-level current_period_start/end moved to SubscriptionItem. Documented as nonnullable timestamps on items. They are not used to invalidate a delayed historical paid invoice.
historical_period_authority.unchanged_idempotency: Canonical invoice ID and subscription-period identity still feed the approved ledger; different webhook IDs/event order cannot create additional allowance for the same business period.

remaining_gates: Actual Stripe Sandbox canonical response and webhook fixtures under exact pinned API version; currently UNRUN.
Supported/excluded settlement policy acceptance before activation; do not imply universal Stripe billing compatibility.
